status: independent external-validation programme frozen before numeric Height outcomes
role: prospective validation using a source selected outcome-blind after closure of the original Movebank/archive programme; cannot alter frozen v0.3.8 unless separately reopened after validation

source.study_title: Wind energy production in forests conflicts with tree-roosting bats
source.vertical_reference: GPS-estimated height above geoid / mean sea level

cohort_definition.rationale: The source sampled 2019/2020 and early/late-summer field periods; identity exchangeability is restricted within these documented temporal sampling strata.

preflight.repeat_definition: at least two >=50-fix sessions within the same frozen cohort
preflight.target_support: A target fix is structurally supported when its 5-km cell occurs in at least one other eligible session of the same individual and in at least one eligible session from another individual in the same cohort.
preflight.individual_evaluable: at least one target session with >=50 supported target fixes
preflight.gate: At least 5 evaluable repeat individuals across admitted cohorts. Freeze exact cohort/session/individual eligibility before numeric Height is read.

primary_validation_if_preflight_passes.ecological_question: Does repeatable individual centered vertical-distribution identity replicate in an independent common-noctule dataset selected without using vertical outcomes?
primary_validation_if_preflight_passes.vertical_preprocessing: Within each retained session, convert native Height to numeric only after the preflight is frozen, then subtract that session's median Height.
primary_validation_if_preflight_passes.self_weighting: equal eligible training session of the target individual
primary_validation_if_preflight_passes.other_weighting: equal other individual within the same cohort
primary_validation_if_preflight_passes.common_weighting: On 5-km cells supported by both predictors, compute equal-session self cell weights and apply the identical weights to self and other centered vertical profiles.
primary_validation_if_preflight_passes.target_scoring: held-out target-session fixes in common supported cells; minimum 50 fixes
primary_validation_if_preflight_passes.panel_aggregation: equal evaluable individual across admitted cohorts

calibration.preserve: all within-session x-y-time-centered-z data and exact original session-count multiset per identity label

primary_validation_if_preflight_passes.pass_rule: exact preflight-frozen evaluable n; observed-minus-null-mean common-cell centered identity > 0; one-sided p(null >= observed) <= 0.05

staged_mechanism_extension.rule: Do not open mechanism replication unless the independent centered-shape primary validation passes.
possible_next_tests: speed×turn kinematic-state conditioning using source x-y-time only
500-m fine-place × kinematic matching if an outcome-blind support preflight passes
>=1-day temporal-persistence replication if an outcome-blind lag-support preflight passes
source-provided move_state as a secondary externally defined behavioural proxy, only under a separately frozen contract

claim_boundary: The source was selected because it passed a frozen structural gate, not because of its vertical behavior.
The primary validation tests centered full-distribution identity, not any single tail/concentration component.
A PASS is independent evidence for repeatable organization of vertical space use in another taxon and tracking programme; it does not identify mechanism.
A FAIL does not invalidate the original five-panel result; it limits generality.
The original v0.3.8 manuscript remains frozen during this validation.
stop_rule: Do not change cohort definition, 5-km grid, >=50-fix session/target thresholds, vertical bins, weighting, permutation unit, B, seed or pass rule after preflight or vertical output.
Do not pool across year×field_period cohorts to rescue a failed primary test.
Do not open kinematic/fine-place/persistence mechanism extensions if the independent primary centered-shape test fails.
Do not substitute another external source after seeing this source's vertical outcome.
